name: James Madison University Direct Entry

programs.title: Direct Admit Undergraduate
programs.summary: If you meet the appropriate language requirement of IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 80 and academic requirement of a 2.5 Grade Point Average, you can apply directly to any of our academic programs at James Madison University.

description: James Madison University is in Harrisonburg, Virginia and offers students an exciting, vibrant, and all-American student experience.
